episodes.synopsis: Tanuma gives Natsume some clay, and he tries his hand at sculpting a figure. However, the next day, the figure has disappeared, and other strange things are happening in the house. Is a Yōkai causing mischief in the house? Or is it just a rat?
episodes.title: The Fragment's Lament

episodes.synopsis: Natsume is forced to help rebuild a tiny house that's a residence for a goddess.
episodes.title: Someday's Garden

episodes.synopsis: Natsume is caught up in a mysterious game between youkai and man.
episodes.title: Tookanya

episodes.synopsis: Natsume and Kitamoto are victims of a horrid curse.
episodes.title: Depths of the Page

episodes.synopsis: Chobi is depressed because his favorite comb broke. Meanwhile, Natsume sees a white dragon in the sky...
episodes.title: Chobi's Treasure

episodes.synopsis: Natsume meets Matoba in an unusual place. Matoba hunts for a dangerous yokai at an abandoned mansion.
episodes.title: The Abandoned Station, Two Wheels

episodes.synopsis: Taki's brother suddenly comes home from college, and has something very important on his mind...
episodes.title: A Difficult Two

episodes.synopsis: Nishimura finds Natsume coming to visit him each night at his house, but something seems strange...
episodes.title: Natsume on the Moonlit Night

episodes.synopsis: Natsume finds himself in a house with a strange ritual, and unknown forces moving against those who would perform it.
episodes.title: That Which Blocks the Ceremony

episodes.synopsis: Natsume, Natori and Matoba work to complete the ritual to welcome a powerful god.
episodes.title: The House Where a Promise Remains

episodes.synopsis: Natsume meets the very first Yokai whose name was written in the Book of Friends.
episodes.title: Tell Me Your Name

episodes.synopsis: Natsume takes in a strange origami doll that shows wonderful dreams.
episodes.title: From the Path of Dreams
